sara_cust: Hey — hitting a regression: structured/json-mode + streaming returns invalid JSON when backslashes or \u escapes are split across chunks.

sara_cust: Example (chunks we received):
```json
chunkA: {"partial":"{\"path\":\"C:\\Users\\build\",\"msg\":\"it\\u201"}
chunkB: {"partial":"9s a test\",\"more\":true}
```

ashley_support: Yikes. Can you share the exact API call + headers and model? Also which SDK/version?

devin_eng: Likely chunk boundary split on the serialized JSON string. If the runtime emits chunks mid-escape (e.g. "\u201" + "9s") the final concatenation is valid but a parser that attempts to parse per-chunk will fail. Is the client parsing each chunk as its own JSON object?

sara_cust: We're doing streaming incremental parse; we buffer but we saw a parse error thrown before buffer finished. Attaching curl we used:
```bash
curl -s -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-structured-1","mode":"json","input":"describe path","stream":true}'
```

zheng_ml: Model: rwd-structured-1, quantized: off. Possible causes: runtime chunking behavior and the SDK's decoder treating chunks as independent JSON frames. Can you confirm client libs and whether you're using `await response.json()` per chunk?

ashley_support: I've opened ticket INF-4821 and pinged eng-runtime. support-bot: INF-4821 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821 :eyes:

devin_eng: Quick mitigations: 1) Buffer until you confirm your stream payload is complete (e.g., closing brace). 2) Treat chunks as text stream and only parse after reassembly. We'll add a note to streaming docs.

sara_cust: Ok will try buffering. If this reappears after buffering, we'll attach full HAR and logs.

ashley_support: Thanks — keeping this thread open. :thumbsup:
